select info.PROD_ID ,info.PROD_NAME ,info.PROD_RE ,info.SET_DATE ,info.ACCT_CHNNAME ,nvl(plan.SETT_DATE,info.MDATE) mDate ,plan.BONUS_PLAN_ID from REP_PROD_INFO info left join DIS_PROD_BONUSPLAN plan on info.PROD_ID = plan.PROD_ID and plan.BONUS_MODE = '02' and plan.DATA_STATUS = 'E' where info.STATUS = 'E'
and info.PROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
